data.body:
[P2] Revisit the untested parent-index pruning branch

This breaks CONTRIBUTING rule 4, “Every branch has a test that fails without it.” Removing this branch leaves empty parent-index entries, but every index-emptiness assertion runs after invocation End unconditionally clears the state. The sibling regression also checks delivery only after finalization, whose scan of `pending` masks an incorrectly removed sibling index. Consequently, the tests do not establish the new index-retention contract. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, as rule 9 requires, and justify the necessary state transitions with tests that distinguish them from final cleanup.
